Before running the full evaluation, we check that the BGMM and DPMM samplers
converge and that NetC14's loss stabilizes. We simulate one chronology for
each combination of sample size and distribution, holding the interval at 2500
years and the number of clusters at three. For each chronology, we run four
chains of the BGMM and DPMM with different seeds and compute the
rank-normalized split $\hat{R}$ (Vehtari et al 2021) on label-invariant
quantities: the density $p(t)$ at 100 evenly spaced years and, for the
DPMM, the concentration parameter $\alpha$ and the calendar age of each sample.
Values of $\hat{R}$ below 1.01 indicate that the chains agree.

Mixture posteriors are multimodal, and Hamiltonian Monte Carlo cannot move
between well-separated modes. Following Price et al (2021), who start all
chains from the same parameter vector, every BGMM chain starts from the
posterior mode for the selected number of components, jittered by its seed.
The number of components and the mode do not depend on the seed, so the four
chains target the same posterior, and $\hat{R}$ for the BGMM measures mixing
around that mode rather than across all modes.

We also trace the Kullback-Leibler divergence of each iteration's density
from the mean density over the first 10% of iterations, following
`carbondate::PlotConvergenceData()`, and record NetC14's loss at each epoch.

```{r}
#| label: function-mixture-diagnostics
#| file: R/mixture-diagnostics.R
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: R/mixture-diagnostics.R
#| eval: false
```

```{r}
#| label: convergence-test
#| cache: true
#| time_it: true
#| output: false
convergence_grid <- expand.grid(
  n_samples = c(50, 250, 1250),
  distribution = c("gaussian", "uniform", "skewed"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

chains <- 1:4

# R-hat for each column of a parameter, e.g., each year of the density
rhat_table <- function(fits, parameter, ...) {
  draws <- lapply(fits, get_draws, parameter = parameter, ...)
  draws <- simplify2array(draws)
  rhats <- apply(draws, 2, rhat)

  data.frame(model = class(fits[[1]])[1], parameter = parameter, rhat = rhats)
}

n_scenarios <- nrow(convergence_grid)

rhat_results <- vector("list", n_scenarios)
kld_results <- vector("list", n_scenarios)
loss_results <- vector("list", n_scenarios)

for (i in seq_len(n_scenarios)) {
  set.seed(STARTREK * 6 + i)

  # scenario
  n_samples <- convergence_grid[["n_samples"]][i]
  distribution <- convergence_grid[["distribution"]][i]
  start <- sample(seq(100, 47000), 1)
  end <- start + 2499
  years <- seq(start, end, by = 25)

  # simulate chronology, draw samples, and calibrate
  chronology <- simulate_chronology(start, end, 3, distribution)
  samples <- sample_dates(chronology, n_samples, intcal20)
  calibrated_dates <- calibrate(samples, intcal20)

  # training
  bgmm_fits <- lapply(chains, \(.seed) bgmm(calibrated_dates, seed = .seed))

  dpmm_fits <- lapply(chains, \(.seed) {
    set.seed(.seed)
    dpmm(samples)
  })

  netc_model <- netc(calibrated_dates)

  # diagnostics
  scenario <- data.frame(
    scenario = i,
    n_samples = n_samples,
    distribution = distribution
  )

  rhats <- rbind(
    rhat_table(bgmm_fits, "density", years = years),
    rhat_table(dpmm_fits, "alpha"),
    rhat_table(dpmm_fits, "density"),
    rhat_table(dpmm_fits, "ages")
  )

  klds <- rbind(
    cbind(
      model = "BGMM",
      kld_trace(get_draws(bgmm_fits[[1]], "density", years = years))
    ),
    cbind(
      model = "DPMM",
      kld_trace(get_draws(dpmm_fits[[1]], "density"))
    )
  )

  rhat_results[[i]] <- cbind(scenario, rhats)
  kld_results[[i]] <- cbind(scenario, klds)
  loss_results[[i]] <- cbind(scenario, attr(netc_model, "training"))
}

rhat_results <- do.call(rbind, rhat_results)
kld_results <- do.call(rbind, kld_results)
loss_results <- do.call(rbind, loss_results)
```

Median and maximum $\hat{R}$ by model, parameter, and sample size (grid years
where the density is constant across all draws return `NaN` and are dropped):

```{r}
#| label: convergence-summary
rhat_summary <- aggregate(
  rhat ~ model + parameter + n_samples,
  data = rhat_results,
  FUN = \(x) c(median = median(x), max = max(x))
)
rhat_summary
```

If any value crosses the threshold, we'll abort the entire analysis.

```{r}
#| label: rhat-check
rhat <- rhat_summary[["rhat"]][, "median"]
if (any(rhat >= 1.01)) {
  msg <- "Median R-hat exceeds 1.01, chains have not converged."
  stop(msg, call. = FALSE)
}
```

**Rank-normalized R-hat**

```{r}
#| label: plot-convergence-rhat
#| code-fold: true
#| output: false
svglite(
  filename = "figures/convergence-rhat.svg",
  width = 3.5,
  height = 3.5
)

par(defaults)
par(mai = c(0.5, 0.5, 0.1, 0.1))

with(rhat_results, {
  sizes <- sort(unique(n_samples))
  x <- match(n_samples, sizes) + ifelse(model == "BGMM", -0.15, 0.15)

  new_plot(xlim = c(0.5, 3.5), ylim = range(c(1, rhat), na.rm = TRUE))
  x_axis(at = seq_along(sizes), labels = sizes)
  y_axis()
  x_label("Number of Samples")
  y_label("R-hat")
  add_grid()

  points(
    jitter(x, amount = 0.08),
    rhat,
    pch = 16,
    cex = 0.4,
    col = adjustcolor(theme(model), alpha.f = 0.4)
  )
})

add_legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c("BGMM", "DPMM"),
  col = theme("BGMM", "DPMM"),
  text.col = theme("BGMM", "DPMM"),
  pch = 16
)

dev.off()
```

:::

**Divergence from Initial Density**

```{r}
#| label: plot-convergence-kld
#| code-fold: true
#| output: false
svglite(
  filename = "figures/convergence-kld.svg",
  width = 5,
  height = 5
)

layout(matrix(1:2))

par(defaults)
par(mai = c(0.2, 0.3, 0.1, 0.1), omi = c(0.4, 0.2, 0, 0))

for (.model in c("BGMM", "DPMM")) {
  .kld <- subset(kld_results, model == .model)

  new_plot(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = range(.kld[["kld"]]))
  y_axis()
  add_grid()

  for (.s in split(.kld, ~scenario)) {
    lines(
      .s[["iter"]] / max(.s[["iter"]]),
      .s[["kld"]],
      col = theme(.model),
      lwd = 0.6
    )
  }

  add_legend("topright", legend = .model, text.col = theme(.model))
}

x_axis()
x_label("Proportion of Iterations", outer = TRUE, line = 0.8)
y_label("KL Divergence", outer = TRUE, line = 0.1)

dev.off()
```

![](/figures/convergence-kld.svg)
:::

**NetC14 Loss**

```{r}
#| label: plot-convergence-loss
#| code-fold: true
#| output: false
svglite(
  filename = "figures/convergence-loss.svg",
  width = 5,
  height = 3.5
)

par(defaults)
par(mai = c(0.5, 0.5, 0.1, 0.1))

new_plot(xlim = range(loss_results[["epoch"]]), ylim = c(0, 1))
x_axis()
y_axis()
x_label("Epoch")
y_label("Scaled Loss")
add_grid()

for (.s in split(loss_results, ~scenario)) {
  .loss <- .s[["total"]]
  lines(
    .s[["epoch"]],
    (.loss - min(.loss)) / diff(range(.loss)),
    col = theme("NetC14"),
    lwd = 0.6
  )
}

dev.off()
```

![](/figures/convergence-loss.svg)
